modelSelection.method: Stratified validation split from training data; fake-class F1, then PR-AUC

dataset.name: Employment Scam Aegean Dataset (EMSCAD)
dataset.license: CC0: Public Domain (as labeled on the Kaggle dataset page)

evaluation.method: Stratified 80/20 held-out test split; random_state=42; duplicate text removed before splitting
evaluation.note: Precision, recall, F1, confusion matrices, and PR-AUC are measured on the untouched test split. Accuracy is included only as a secondary metric.
